# FG-REPO-0033

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `widening_above_a_private_parent_is_refused_and_new_groups_are_private` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 上のグループが非公開なので、ここだけを社内公開にはできません。先に上のグループを社内公開にしてください。
- en: A group above is private, so this cannot be made internal on its own. Make the group above internal first.
- id: Grup di atasnya privat, jadi ini tidak bisa dijadikan internal sendiri. Jadikan grup di atasnya internal terlebih dahulu.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 15 MR 3 (ADR-0010 Amendment "グループの可視性"): the effective visibility of a group or project is the narrowest on its chain to the top level, so a value wider than the parent's would have no effect and is refused instead of stored: `PATCH /api/v1/groups/{id}/visibility` or `POST /api/v1/groups/{id}/subgroups` asking for `internal` below a group whose effective visibility is `private`, or `PUT /api/v1/projects/{id}/visibility` asking for `internal` for a project below such a group. Decided inside the write transaction on the stored values, after authorization. An operation error, not a server fault: no alert, no runbook. Nothing is written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason` (`group_above_private` / `project_above_private`), `group_id` or `project_id`, and `request_id`. Read the chain read-only: GET /api/v1/groups/{parent id} (its `effective_visibility`), or SELECT n.full_path, g.visibility FROM forge.namespaces n JOIN forge.groups g ON n.kind = 'group' AND g.id = n.owner_id WHERE n.full_path IN (<the parent paths>).

## 対処 (fix)

Make the private group above internal first (its Owner, PATCH /api/v1/groups/{id}/visibility), or keep this one private. Nothing to change on the server.
